thread:
nina: Quick one — a user hitting the new quickstart saw a 402 on their first SDK call and got stuck. They pasted the client error and said there was no guidance in the UI.

keith: Can you paste the server log? 402 usually means workspace needs billing.

nina: Sure — server shows: ```json
{
  "status": 402,
  "message": "billing_required: workspace incomplete",
  "request_id": "req_a1b2c3"
}
```

alex: Thanks — couple things to improve: (1) JS SDK currently retries once for 4xx in some codepaths; that makes 402 look transient. We should treat 402 as non-retriable onboarding error. (2) The sample app logs a terse axios stack but doesn't point users to the org billing page.

nina: Repro steps from the user: clone `redwood-quickstart`, `yarn`, set `REDWOOD_KEY`, `yarn dev`, open the demo, click "Send". First outbound request -> 402.

keith: Also worth noting: when folks run `vercel dev` or `netlify dev`, the dev proxy sometimes strips `x-workspace-id` header and the request lands on the wrong workspace -> unexpected billing gate. We've seen this before.

alex: Proposed fixes:
- SDK: map HTTP 402 -> OnboardingBillingError, include `help_url` to `https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/<org>/billing`, and mark as non-retriable (samir/keith to PR).
- Samples: detect missing `x-workspace-id` and console.warn with a short remediation note.
- Docs: quick troubleshooting snippet in quickstart README showing how to check workspace billing state in the console.

marco: I'll take sample warning + README patch. I'll add a dev-mode hint printed to the server console: "Missing x-workspace-id: if using Vercel CLI, set `forwardHeaders: true` or run with `vercel dev --local-config`".

sdk-bot: Suggested automated DM template: "Hi! It looks like your organization hasn't completed billing setup. Visit https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/billing to finish setup or contact support if you believe this is an error."

alex: Also, please add a Sentry grouping key for these onboarding errors (group by `error_type:onboarding_billing` and include `request_id` and `workspace_id` as breadcrumbs, but never include keys or tokens).

keith: One other nit: the Python and Go SDKs currently surface HTTP 402 differently. We should standardize across SDKs so docs and support can point to a single remediation flow. I'll open a cross-SDK issue for parity.

nina: Solid. Timeline? Marco/Marco: sample + README today. SDK PR -> 2d. Cross-SDK parity issue -> keith. Support will DM the user with the docs link for now.

marco: Pushing sample fix in a minute. I'll log the exact console text so support can match it.

nina: Thanks team. This should reduce first-call confusion a lot. :thumbsup:
